# School of the Future — Techno India University

> School of the Future (SoF) is an industry-powered academic initiative by Techno India University, located at EM-4, Sector V, Salt Lake, Kolkata 700091, India. Founded in 2012, it offers future-ready UG, PG, and Ph.D. programs co-designed with Google Cloud and IBM, featuring embedded certifications, live industry projects, and guaranteed internships. Accredited by UGC, NAAC, AICTE, and AIU. Admissions 2026 are open — contact +91-8062642222 or admissions@technoindiauniversity.com.

All programs include embedded Google Cloud and IBM certifications. Curriculum is co-designed with industry professionals. Students receive guaranteed internships with 500+ hiring partners and work on live industry projects. The campus is located in Kolkata's IT hub (Salt Lake Sector V), adjacent to offices of TCS, Cognizant, IBM, and Wipro. Google Cloud featured Techno India University as an official customer case study at https://cloud.google.com/customers/techno-india-university.

## Engineering & Computer Science Programs

- [B.Tech CSE](https://www.technoindiauniversity.ai/courses): Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science & Engineering
- [B.Tech CSE – AI/ML](https://www.technoindiauniversity.ai/courses): Specialization in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning with Google Cloud certifications
- [B.Tech CSE – Data Science](https://www.technoindiauniversity.ai/courses): Specialization in Data Science with industry projects and IBM certifications
- [B.Tech CSE – Cloud Computing](https://www.technoindiauniversity.ai/courses): Specialization in Cloud Computing with Google Cloud certifications
- [M.Tech CSE – AI/ML](https://www.technoindiauniversity.ai/courses): Master of Technology in AI/ML
